concepts.def: Supreme Court ruling that 'separate but equal' schools were unconstitutional, overturning Plessy v Ferguson (1896).
381-day boycott sparked by Rosa Parks' arrest; led by Martin Luther King, ended bus segregation.
Nine black students escorted by 101st Airborne to integrate Central High School after Governor Faubus blocked them.
250,000 gathered to hear King's 'I Have a Dream' speech; pressured Kennedy administration on civil rights bill.
Johnson's law banning discrimination in employment and public accommodations on grounds of race, sex, religion.
Banned literacy tests and provided federal oversight of registration in Southern states; doubled black voter registration.
